text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializeInTranslating(x, y) ::: x specializes in translating y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.

Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ ∀x (Book(x) ∧ Publish(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English. All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ∧ Publish(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ∧ TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press. Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ∧ Publish(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.

Conclusion:
TranslatedFrom(palaceOfFlies, italian) ::: Palace of Flies was translated from Italian.
